text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vowing to defeat Hishi Akebono, Taiki 
Shuttle is getting stronger, faster, and 
even more buff once again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by her, Hishi Akebono whipped up 
a massive high-protein meal in her quest 
to become even stronger, faster, and more 
muscular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono and I continued to 
spend our days training hard together side 
by side—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference right before the 
Mile CS, she issues a direct declaration 
of war against Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public was buzzing with excitement 
over this clash of fated rivals, and 
expectations for the Mile Championship 
skyrocketed even further!
